summary: Master supply chain finance and working capital with practical metrics, financing structures, and dashboards. Enroll to improve liquidity and supplier continuit
lede: Supply chain finance training helps treasury, procurement, accounts payable and receivable professionals assess how financing and payment choices affect working capital. Participants practice measuring net working capital and cash-conversion metrics, comparing financing structures, and analyzing supplier and funding risks to develop a practical action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who sit at the intersection of cash, procurement, and supply chain performance. You should see your role reflected in the daily work of managing invoices, supplier terms, funding requests, cash conversion metrics, and leadership reporting.
prerequisites: You should arrive with a baseline understanding of working-capital concepts, invoice cycles, and supply chain operations. Bring a laptop with Excel or a compatible spreadsheet tool and, if possible, sample data for receivables, payables, inventory, and invoice aging.
